Bull-Catcher Style.descriptionOnly: no path: a readied grapple against a charging foe, +2

Claw Wrench.descriptionOnly: no path: its –5 and +2 are on the grapple checks its actions make

Dimensional Step Up.descriptionOnly: no path: following a teleporting foe, once a day

Expanded Hunter Tactics.descriptionOnly: no path: a teamwork feat it lends an ally for rounds

choices.label: Focused Aberration Expertise: the saving throw

Focused Aberration Expertise.descriptionOnly: the save picked holds against any such effect, the other against aberrations' spells and abilities

Focused Animal Expertise.descriptionOnly: against animals the rest of its favored enemy (animal) bonus, the whole of it

Focused Construct Expertise.descriptionOnly: no path: its attacks ignore DR or hardness of half its favored enemy (construct) bonus, the full bonus against constructs, at the table

Focused Dragon Expertise.descriptionOnly: no damage on a Reflex save against a dragon's ability that halves it (stalwart with evasion), at the table

Focused Fey Expertise.descriptionOnly: its weapon attacks are cold iron against fey, at the table

Focused Ooze Expertise.descriptionOnly: against oozes the rest of its favored enemy (ooze) bonus, the whole of it; its acid resistance against oozes is the whole bonus too, at the table

Focused Outsider Expertise.descriptionOnly: no path: its attacks ignore aligned DR of half its favored enemy (outsider) bonus, the full bonus against its subtype, at the table

Focused Plant Expertise.descriptionOnly: its weapons' critical multipliers are one higher against plants, at the table

Focused Target.descriptionOnly: no path: +1 to its studied target bonus in one category for each target it gives up, at the table

Focused Undead Expertise.descriptionOnly: its use, once a day, negates the ability damage, drain or negative levels of an undead's natural attack

Focused Vermin Expertise.descriptionOnly: it doesn't stack with other damage reduction; its bonus on Fortitude saves against a swarm's distraction is the damage it prevented, at the table

Grisly Ornament.descriptionOnly: no path: an ornament's morale bonus by its monster's CR

Harvest Parts.descriptionOnly: its rules change no number the sheet keeps

Knowledgeable Spellcaster.descriptionOnly: no path: learning less about a creature for its spells, at the table

Monstrous Disguise.descriptionOnly: its disguise as a monstrous humanoid takes 1d3 hours

Monstrous Masquerade.descriptionOnly: no path: in its disguise, one ability it picks of the creature's: climb 10 feet, fly 20 feet, swim 20 feet, damage reduction 3/magic or resist 5 of one energy, at the table

Needle in a Haystack.descriptionOnly: no path: +2 insight against surprise by a tracked creature, +4 at 10 ranks

Pacify Animal.descriptionOnly: no path: the DC of 10 (15 for a companion) + the target's Hit Dice + its Charisma modifier is its wild empathy check's, at the table

Punishing Step.descriptionOnly: no path: Dodge's bonus made 2 for its CMD is told here

Resisting Grappler.descriptionOnly: no path: its hit counts as 5 more damage toward the penalty on the grabbing creature's grapple check

Shared Quarry.descriptionOnly: no path: the +1 insight on attacks against its quarry (+4 to confirm a critical hit) is the allies' sharing its favored enemy bonus; an animal companion's full quarry is the companion's
